$comment: Generated by fixtures/pdf/build-manifest.mjs. §16.2 requires nine things per fixture; tools/test-fixtures.mjs checks all nine are present and that the hash is the file's actual hash, so a fixture edited by hand fails rather than quietly becoming its own label.

document-metadata.positive.pdf.label: document-metadata.must_detect
document-metadata.positive.pdf.labelDefinition: §7.1 — standard document metadata, including author, creator, producer, title, subject, keywords, and timestamps. carries the disclosure this category names; a detector that misses it is a release blocker under §17.1
document-metadata.positive.pdf.generatedBy: fixtures/pdf/generate.mjs, raw PDF syntax, deterministic and uncompressed
document-metadata.positive.pdf.annotationInstructions: The positive carries an /Info dictionary with seven populated fields. The control has no /Info at all. Label the positive for every field present, not once for the dictionary.

javascript-and-launch.positive.pdf.label: javascript-and-launch.must_detect
javascript-and-launch.positive.pdf.labelDefinition: §7.1 — document-level JavaScript and launch actions. carries the disclosure this category names; a detector that misses it is a release blocker under §17.1
javascript-and-launch.positive.pdf.generatedBy: fixtures/pdf/generate.mjs, raw PDF syntax, deterministic and uncompressed
javascript-and-launch.positive.pdf.annotationInstructions: The positive has both document-level JavaScript and a launch action. The control has an /OpenAction too - a benign GoTo - so a detector keying on /OpenAction rather than on its /S fails here. Expect review_required, not blocking: E1 set both categories to high, and §7.2's concern is that a user cannot judge a script, not that every script is disclosure.
